Remark
[Low eigenspaces of the linearized map-Laplacian] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0282, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0283 1. ch34:34.7\group Harmonic Maps on Spheres

On the unit sphere, the eigenspace of $L_{g_{\mathrm{sph}}}$ of eigenvalue $2-n$ consists of the closed one-forms with Hodge eigenvalue $n$, its kernel consists of the coclosed one-forms with Hodge eigenvalue $2(n-1)$, and all its other eigenvalues are positive.
